dedupe_keys.name: rectifhyd annual to monthly hydropower disaggregation

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes the R scripts that reproduce RectifHyd by distributing annual hydropower generation across months using reservoir releases and river-flow proxies. The README describes processing EIA spreadsheets, obtaining gauge flows, preparing release or flow fractions, combining estimates and exporting the final table. It names ResOpsUS, EIA-923, HILARRI, hydropower assets and USGS water records as required inputs. Coverage follows the United States plant inventory and source years; the current workflow references generation spreadsheets through 2022. Source is freely available on GitHub, and the own LICENSE states BSD 2-Clause. The model can prepare seasonal supply constraints for power simulations alongside data-godeeep-hydro-power-system-ready-hydropower. A caveat is that downstream flow and reservoir release are imperfect proxies for electricity production, particularly where storage or operational decisions alter the relationship. Reproduction also requires obtaining the separate source datasets and matching their versions. No R scripts were executed.
